name: Distance Transformation (Proximity Clouds)
definition: A technique for fast 3D grid traversal using a 3D distance map generated from binary volumes, where each cell contains the distance to the nearest non-empty cell.
summary: Distance Transformation, or Proximity Clouds, accelerates ray traversal by storing distance-to-nearest-object data in a flat 3D volume, enabling O(1) empty-space skipping without hierarchical tree navigation.
